005package org.wpilib.hardware.discrete;
006
007import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.AnalogInputJNI;
008import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.SimDevice;
009import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryLoggable;
010import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
011import org.wpilib.util.UsageReporting;
012
013/**
014 * Analog channel class.
015 *
016 * <p>Each analog channel is read from hardware as a 12-bit number representing 0V to 3.3V.
017 */
018public class AnalogInput implements TelemetryLoggable, AutoCloseable {
019  int m_port; // explicit no modifier, private and package accessible.
020  private int m_channel;
021
022  /**
023   * Construct an analog channel.
024   *
025   * @param channel The SmartIO channel for the analog input.
026   */
027  public AnalogInput(final int channel) {
028    AnalogInputJNI.checkAnalogInputChannel(channel);
029    m_channel = channel;
030
031    m_port = AnalogInputJNI.initializeAnalogInputPort(channel);
032
033    UsageReporting.reportUsage("IO", channel, "AnalogInput");
034  }
035
036  @Override
037  public void close() {
038    AnalogInputJNI.freeAnalogInputPort(m_port);
039    m_port = 0;
040    m_channel = 0;
041  }
042
043  /**
044   * Get a sample straight from this channel. The sample is a 12-bit value representing the 0V to
045   * 3.3V range of the A/D converter. The units are in A/D converter codes. Use GetVoltage() to get
046   * the analog value in calibrated units.
047   *
048   * @return A sample straight from this channel.
049   */
050  public int getValue() {
051    return AnalogInputJNI.getAnalogValue(m_port);
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Get a scaled sample straight from this channel. The value is scaled to units of Volts.
056   *
057   * @return A scaled sample straight from this channel.
058   */
059  public double getVoltage() {
060    return AnalogInputJNI.getAnalogVoltage(m_port);
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Get the channel number.
065   *
066   * @return The channel number.
067   */
068  public int getChannel() {
069    return m_channel;
070  }
071
072  /**
073   * Indicates this input is used by a simulated device.
074   *
075   * @param device simulated device handle
076   */
077  public void setSimDevice(SimDevice device) {
078    AnalogInputJNI.setAnalogInputSimDevice(m_port, device.getNativeHandle());
079  }
080
081  @Override
082  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
083    table.log("Value", getVoltage());
084  }
085
086  @Override
087  public String getTelemetryType() {
088    return "Analog Input";
089  }
090}
